name: Laxmi Dental Ltd
title: Laxmi Dental Ltd - 544339 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Q4 FY26 revenue up 21.9% to Rs 74 cr with EBITDA margin 18.3%, but no capacity discipline signals; management refused numeric FY27 guidance and Bizdent pricing was traded for margin.

capex.quote: We have done a CAPEX of around Rs. 18.4 crores in FY '26.

triggers.label: Bizdent pricing pressure accepted for margin
triggers.quote: we wanted on our side as management to preserve the margins. And I think we have done that.

triggers.label: Q4 revenue up 22% YoY
triggers.quote: Revenue for Q4 FY '26 stood at INR 74 crores, representing year-on-year growth of 22%.

triggers.label: No numeric FY27 margin or growth guidance
triggers.quote: I wish I could guide you at this point in time.

triggers.label: Funded competitors entering domestic aligners
triggers.quote: in the past, probably non funded competitors and now funded competitors.

prior_guidance_check.metric: FY27/FY28 EBITDA margin 18-20% and gross margin 75-80%

red_flags.label: Management declines to guide; Bizdent pricing pressure
red_flags.quote: we will keep evaluating whether in terms of putting pressure on the pricing versus margins and growing

evasions.quote: calling out anything today based on the current situation is not what we want to do today.
to give you a pinpoint number today as on today may not be possible.
we always see if the growth is coming at the cost of the margins, then we always have a balanced approach.
